name: basalt
description: A simple, fast terminal for macOS and Linux with visual completions, block folding, easy shell switching, and built-in SSH and remote file transfer.
author: Ethan W

scripts.test: node test/blocks.test.mjs && node test/completions.test.mjs && node test/ssh.test.mjs && node test/ssh-ops.test.mjs && electron test/platform.test.cjs
scripts.install-app: npm run package && npm run sign && rm -rf /Applications/Basalt.app && ditto dist/Basalt-darwin-arm64/Basalt.app /Applications/Basalt.app
